chronological_nested_search.partition: split ordered outer-training sessions into five contiguous blocks with sizes differing by at most one; assign any remainder to earlier blocks
chronological_nested_search.prediction_blocks: for block j in {2,3,4,5}, fit model, transforms, nested CDFs, and guardrail references only on blocks before j after removing the chronologically last preceding session as a one-session embargo; score block j exactly once
chronological_nested_search.first_block: fit warmup only; it produces no scored prediction
chronological_nested_search.no_transduction: a scored block, chronological future block, outer validation, census-only row outside the fit sessions, live row, and protected row may not enter its model, transform, CDF, threshold, or calibrator
chronological_nested_search.identity_rule: each prediction carries outer_fold, inner_block, session, decision_time, exact source-neutral contract identity, model hash, feature hash, label hash, CDF hash, and action-mask hash

final_outer_fit_and_disjoint_calibration.ordered_sessions: sort the outer-training role by session date
final_outer_fit_and_disjoint_calibration.embargo: remove the single session immediately preceding the calibration sessions from every model, transform, CDF, threshold, calibration, and score fit
final_outer_fit_and_disjoint_calibration.final_model_fit_sessions: all earlier outer-training sessions before the embargo
final_outer_fit_and_disjoint_calibration.same_model_rule: fit the final model once on final_model_fit_sessions, predict disjoint calibration_sessions once, fit every final calibrator from those predictions, and never refit or update the model afterward
final_outer_fit_and_disjoint_calibration.composer_choices: architecture, loss weights, alpha, k, CDF algorithm, and every thresholding rule freeze from chronological nested search before the disjoint calibration labels are inspected
final_outer_fit_and_disjoint_calibration.reference_distributions: nested empirical CDFs and guardrail reference distributions use final_model_fit_sessions only
calibration_uses: selected-contract regret mean and upper bound
final_outer_fit_and_disjoint_calibration.outer_validation: predicted once after all artifacts hash-freeze; it never alters them

continuous.method: same-final-model disjoint split conformalized quantile regression
continuous.finite_sample_order: k=min(n,ceil((n+1)*coverage)); qhat is the kth sorted nonconformity score using one-based indexing
continuous.q50: raw same-model q50 with calibration error reported; it does not define a conservative bound
continuous.composer_use: higher-good conservative q10 uses calibrated lower endpoint; lower-good conservative q90 uses calibrated upper endpoint
continuous.fit_source: predictions from the frozen final model on only its disjoint calibration sessions

distribution_calibration.binary: isotonic regression fit on same-final-model disjoint calibration predictions with increasing mapping, deterministic pooled-adjacent-violators ties, and clipped [0,1] output
distribution_calibration.discrete_survival: isotonic cumulative-incidence calibration separately at every registered causally available horizon on the disjoint calibration sessions
distribution_calibration.count: isotonic calibration of cumulative probabilities on the disjoint calibration sessions

phase_specific_rule.fallback: globally pooled disjoint-calibration mapping of the same head and horizon

forbidden: reuse of residuals from a different earlier-block model for the final model

guardrail_thresholds.method: objective_spec.json nested session-balanced empirical distribution with higher-good q=alpha and lower-good q=1-alpha
guardrail_thresholds.implementation_requirement: FT2-30 must prove canonical knot, tie, interpolation, weighting, premium-band, phase, and fallback behavior on synthetic fixtures
guardrail_thresholds.zero_arm: alpha=0.0 skips quality thresholds and remains a mandatory control arm
guardrail_thresholds.fallback: same premium band pooled across model-fit phases; no cross-premium-band fallback

selection_order: retain and evaluate every alpha=0.0 no-screen arm
discard any selectable setting that fails the FT2-11 tail guard
discard settings outside the diagnostic design trade-rate band
maximize the diagnostic inner objective in objective_spec.json
prefer smaller nonzero alpha; alpha=0.0 remains a control and is selectable only if it wins the same frozen rule

design_trade_rate_band_mean_trades_per_s.purpose: broad diagnostic target preventing stacked abstention from silently starving the candidate

joint_conservatism.no_setting_in_band: joint_calibration_insufficient; do not inspect outer evidence

uncertainty.model_ensemble: three independent seeds with median quantile aggregation
uncertainty.epistemic: 1.4826 times median absolute deviation of seed q50 values
uncertainty.gap_conformal: same-final-model disjoint 0.90 finite-sample conformal quantile of selected-cluster-versus-best-outside-cluster gap error
uncertainty.source_transfer: candidate-specific p95 absolute cluster-gap drift from source_transfer_gate
uncertainty.activation_without_source_evidence: historical component research may remain source_transfer_unavailable; any live, decision-shadow, or paper activation fails closed

action_conditioned_gate.name: Protocol101EntryActionConditionedCalibrationGateV2

wait_reliability.outcome: 1 only when the frozen realized-label audit composer on the exact risk set says WAIT; audit outcome is never a runtime input
wait_reliability.binning: 10 equal-frequency bins ordered by calibrated p_wait; ties remain together; merge the smallest adjacent bins left-to-right until every bin has at least 10 observations

selected_contract_regret.prediction: same-final-model expected regret and conformalized 90 percent upper bound from forecast_heads.json

action_conditioned_gate.ft2_11_requirement: FT2-11 repair must include every threshold, minimum, and artifact above in the all-required entry-component checklist

source_transfer_gate.name: Protocol101EntryHistoricalIBKRTransferV2
source_transfer_gate.authority_boundary: candidate-specific activation prerequisite; it is not satisfied by two implementations consuming the same IBKR observation

population.allowed: only already-recorded paired sessions classified development by the sealed-day governance manifest
forbidden: new recorder collection under this repair
population.pair_key: session_date_yyyymmdd, completed decision_time_ns, source_neutral_contract_id, expiry_yyyymmdd, strike_milli_points, right_code
population.missing_required_natural_stratum: source_transfer_insufficient; synthetic fixtures may prove machinery but cannot manufacture empirical source evidence
population.recorder_status: deliberately stopped by owner decision; no pass condition assumes another paired day will appear

field_tolerances.extension_inactive: exact inactive mask and zero model contribution

score_gap_margin.quantity: absolute difference between historical and IBKR selected-cluster-versus-best-outside-cluster primary-score gaps on paired decisions
score_gap_margin.p95: nearest-rank order statistic k=ceil(0.95*n), one-based, no interpolation
score_gap_margin.zero_allowed: only when every paired gap is bit-identical
score_gap_margin.artifact: candidate-specific source_transfer_gap_p95.json plus identity manifest and hashes

source_transfer_gate.activation: all exact fields, numeric tolerances, action agreement, minimum evidence, present strata, and p95 artifact must pass
source_transfer_gate.insufficient_existing_data: historical component research may continue with transfer unavailable; live/shadow/paper activation remains blocked and no new collection is authorized here

hashing.canonical_json: UTF-8 sorted keys compact separators no NaN or Infinity
required_hashes: inner fit and score identity manifests
final model-fit, embargo, and disjoint-calibration session manifests
source-transfer population, tolerances, and margin when applicable
